observations: Two framed solar panels lean against an exterior wall. Panels show dark cells with white grid lines in silver aluminum frames. A semi-transparent watermark reading "IZUTECH SOLAR ENERGY" overlays the image. No battery, inverter, or charge controller is visible in the photo. No readable specification label, brand name, or wattage is visible on the panels. Background shows a paved yard and part of a motorcycle. The seller's reply adds no new photo or visual evidence.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows solar panels only; no battery or charge test is visible, and the seller's verbal claim is not proof.

claims.claim: Izutech solar energy specialize in all solar equipment such as: Inverter, panels, charge...
claims.evidence: seller's text only; not proven by photo 0.

claims.claim: I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true.
claims.evidence: no test video, photo, or screenshot was provided; the seller's statement alone is not visual proof.

risks.risk: Panel wattage and electrical rating are unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the specification label on the back of a panel.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unrated used panel at lowest value.

risks.risk: Panel condition cannot be confirmed (cracks, delamination, moisture, dead cells).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of cell surfaces, frame corners, junction box, or a sunlight output test video.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-working or damaged panels.

risks.risk: Listing text describes a battery while the photo shows panels; the item for sale may be mismatched.
risks.proof: Photo of the battery if one is included, or seller confirmation of exactly what is being sold.
risks.if_unproven: priced as panels only with no battery value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the specification label on the back of one panel.
Video of the panel generating power under sunlight.
Clarification and photo of the battery if a battery is part of the sale.
response.reason: The photo shows solar panels, so the item is identifiable by type and can be priced at its worst case as used panels of unknown rating; the seller's verbal claim of testing adds no visual proof and does not change the worst-case valuation.
